meta.title: Outlive
meta.description: Hand commands and whole tasks to a systemd unit outside the harness: a restart does not interrupt them, and the result comes back to the session.
meta.detail:
Every background job the harness starts (including bash run_in_background) is a child of the dsh web process, so restarting it kills the work. This plugin never executes anything itself: it writes a script, hands it to a transient systemd unit in another cgroup, and afterwards only reads the log and exit marker on disk.

Five tools: outlive_run for one command, outlive_agent to hand a whole task to a detached coding agent, outlive_engines to see which agent CLIs this machine has (opencode / codex / claude, auto-detected), outlive_status / outlive_list to read the ledger, outlive_cancel to stop one. A sidebar panel lists every job with its progress and log tail.
